# MaaFramework native API

MaaFramework `5.1.4` at `c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d`.

- **MaaContext.h**: C API declarations for task context and custom task operations. [`include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaContext.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaContext.h)
- **MaaController.h**: C API declarations for screen capture, input, and device control. [`include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaController.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaController.h)
- **MaaCustomController.h**: Callback interface for implementing a custom controller. [`include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaCustomController.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaCustomController.h)
- **MaaResource.h**: C API declarations for loading pipelines, models, and resources. [`include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaResource.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaResource.h)
- **MaaTasker.h**: C API declarations for task execution and runtime coordination. [`include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaTasker.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/Instance/MaaTasker.h)
- **MaaAPI.h**: Umbrella header for the MaaFramework C API. [`include/MaaFramework/MaaAPI.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/MaaAPI.h)
- **MaaDef.h**: Shared MaaFramework handles, identifiers, statuses, and data types. [`include/MaaFramework/MaaDef.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/MaaDef.h)
- **MaaMsg.h**: Callback event message constants and notification categories. [`include/MaaFramework/MaaMsg.h`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/MaaFramework/blob/c03b933d8b36030a7d21ff27f2b77f167ef4ec5d/include/MaaFramework/MaaMsg.h)
